units.source_text: 柏术向美求索的东西，确实不是一种慰藉！

en.t: What Kashiwagi sought from beauty was certainly not a kind of consolation!

units.source_text: 在不言之中，我明白了这一点。

en.t: Without anything being said, I understood that.

units.source_text: 原来他用自己的嘴向尺八的吹北送气的一瞬间，

en.t: It was that in the instant when he sent breath from his own mouth into the mouthpiece of the shakuhachi,

units.source_text: 便在空中造就了美，尔后自己的X型的腿和阴郁的认识，比先前更加清楚而新鲜地保留了下来，

en.t: he created beauty in the air, and afterward his own X-shaped legs and gloomy awareness remained, clearer and fresher than before,

units.source_text: 柏木所喜爱的就是美的无益，

en.t: What Kashiwagi loved was precisely the uselessness of beauty,

units.source_text: 美通过自己体内却不留下任何痕迹，

en.t: the fact that beauty passed through his own body without leaving any trace,

units.source_text: 它绝对不改变任何事物……

en.t: and that it changed absolutely nothing...

units.source_text: 对我来说，假如美也是这样一种东西，那么我的人生不知会变得多么轻松啊。

en.t: For me, if beauty too were something like that, how much easier my life would become.
